commentary.text: 90+9' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.

90+6' 0 - 1 It's a goal! Cedric Bakambu (Betis) bursts into the box to get on the end of a whipped in cross from Angel Ortiz and scores magnificently from close range into the bottom right corner. 0:1.
90+5' Betis control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
90+3' PENALTY APPEAL after Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
90+1' Today's match ends for Pablo Maffeo who will be replaced by Mateu Morey Bauza (Mallorca).
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
90' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca. Juanmi (Betis) fires a shot well wide of the right post from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
88' Betis seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
86' Isco (Betis) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
83' Looks like Dominik Greif (Mallorca) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
82' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Adrian has no trouble gathering it.
80' Cedric Bakambu (Betis) is shown a yellow card by the referee.
79' Great teamplay by Mallorca as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
75' The ball goes out of play and it will be a corner kick.
74' Manuel Pellegrini is forced to make a change. Jesus Rodriguez is unable to continue due to injury, Pablo Garcia (Betis) comes on.
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Robert Navarro leaves the pitch and Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) comes on.
73' We have witnessed a red card for Omar Mascarell (Mallorca).
72' Referee Javier Alberola seems to have made up his mind after reviewing the incident using VAR, and it’s RED for Omar Mascarell (Mallorca).

72' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Omar Mascarell (Mallorca), but referee Javier Alberola must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
72' Jesus Rodriguez (Betis) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee decides to stop play.
70' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
70' Samu Costa (Mallorca) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
69' Samu Costa (Mallorca) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
68' The Mallorca players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
66' Cedric Bakambu (Betis) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
65' Substitution. Abde Ezzalzouli leaves the pitch and is replaced by Juanmi (Betis).
65' Vitor Roque comes off the pitch to be replaced by Cedric Bakambu (Betis).
64' Takuma Asano (Mallorca) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
63' Bittor Alkiza has decided to substitute Cyle Larin and he is replaced by Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca).
63' A substitution has been made. Sergi Darder goes off and Takuma Asano (Mallorca) comes on.
61' The current number of shots on goal is 3:2.
57' The corner from Johan Mojica (Mallorca) is cleared away by the defence.
56' Betis take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
55' Angel Ortiz (Betis) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
55' Betis are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
54' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Betis.
53' Isco (Betis) fires the resulting free kick on goal from a medium range, but sees his shot saved by the goalkeeper. Betis have a corner.
53' Betis are awarded a free kick. Javier Alberola blows his whistle after Sergi Darder (Mallorca) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
51' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the middle of the goal, but Dominik Greif has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
49' Jesus Rodriguez (Betis) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
48' Javier Alberola shows a yellow card to Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) for his blatant foul.
46' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) receives a yellow card from the referee, but it seems like a very harsh decision.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Manuel Pellegrini probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Marc Roca (Betis). He is replaced by Sergi Altimira.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
42' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
41' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
40' Jesus Rodriguez (Betis) picks up an injury.
39' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) latches onto a cross inside the box but fires a poor effort well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.
36' Robert Navarro (Mallorca) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
34' The Betis players are exchanging some short passes.
33' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and flies well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Betis.
31' Corner kick. Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) is ready to send the ball into the box.

31' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players. The referee points to the corner flag and Mallorca will take a corner.
31' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
29' 49:51 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
29' Neat passing move from Betis in order to create new attacking opportunities.
27' Vitor Roque (Betis) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
27' Vitor Roque (Betis) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
24' Marc Roca (Betis) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
21' Robert Navarro (Mallorca) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
18' Isco (Betis) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the bottom right corner, but Dominik Greif was alert and made a comfortable save.
18' Angel Ortiz (Betis) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
17' An attempted cross from Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) is cleared.
16' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
14' Robert Navarro (Mallorca) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
11' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
10' Adrian pulls off a great save to deny Samu Costa (Mallorca), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom right corner.
9' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
8' Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
7' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
5' Betis are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
1' The Betis players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
1' The first half has just begun.
Mallorca will kick the game off.
